paper_title: First results from the WISPDMX radio frequency cavity searches for hidden photon dark matter
notes: WISPDMX first science run: haloscope-type search for hidden photon dark matter using tunable 208 MHz HERA RF cavity (no magnetic field). New 95% CL exclusion limits on kinetic mixing chi. Paper states limits at level ~1e-13 within resonant tuning ranges of four modes (TM010: 0.8602-0.8646 ueV; TE111: 1.3088-1.3358 ueV; TM020: 1.8820-1.8977 ueV) and ~1e-12 for broadband range 0.2-2.07 ueV, steadily increasing at masses below 0.2 ueV (search extends down to 0.4 neV, but no numerical values given for that region so it is not encoded). Data points are order-of-magnitude values from the abstract/text since the full exclusion curve is only shown in figures (Figs. 18-19) without tabulated data. Assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, vesc = 530 km/s, cavity volume 447 L. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
